lede: White Marsh celebrates around THE AVENUE, with a Saturday morning Holiday Parade, an outdoor ice rink and Santa events at the mall and nearby restaurants.
celebrates: THE AVENUE at White Marsh holds its 29th Holiday Parade on Saturday, December 5, with high school marching bands, mascots and dance troops leading up to Santa. Its tree lighting took place November 20 and a menorah lighting follows December 6. The outdoor ice rink is open daily from November through February. Nearby, White Marsh Mall and Dave and Buster's host Santa events, and Perry Hall families join in with a library storytime and a dinner with Santa on Belair Road.
lastyear: THE AVENUE at White Marsh has held its Holiday Parade for decades: Visit Baltimore County listed the 27th parade on Saturday, December 7, 2024, with local high school marching bands, street performers, mascots and dance troops, and said Santa would stay on for Skate with Santa at the rink afterward. The 2026 parade is the 29th, so the 2025 edition was the 28th. The center's tree lighting is also an annual event, with the 2026 edition the 29th.

faq: When is the White Marsh Holiday Parade in 2026?

The 29th Annual Holiday Parade at THE AVENUE at White Marsh is Saturday, December 5, 2026, at 10 am. It is free to watch, with local high school marching bands, street performers, mascots, dance troops and Santa. The center's page does not print a route.
Is there ice skating in White Marsh?

Yes. THE AVENUE's outdoor ice rink is open seven days a week from November through February. Tickets, parties and fundraisers are booked at whitemarshiceskating.com, and the center's events page does not print prices, so check the ticket site for hours and pricing before you go.
Where can kids see Santa in White Marsh?

Sensory Santa at White Marsh Mall and Breakfast with Santa at Dave and Buster's are listed on this page, and Perry Hall families can use the Dinner with Santa on Belair Road listing. The parade also ends with Santa, so a morning at THE AVENUE on December 5 can include both a parade and a visit.
Is there a Christmas tree lighting in White Marsh?

THE AVENUE held its 29th Annual Holiday Tree Lighting on November 20, 2026, with live music and Skate with Santa. A menorah lighting follows on December 6, according to the county's Let There Be Lights guide and the center.
What is nearby for a bigger day out?

Baltimore's Inner Harbor has Christmas Village and the B&O Railroad Museum runs holiday trains. Our Baltimore guide lists them with dates and prices, including Christmas Village, The Polar Express Train Ride and the Mayor's Christmas Parade.
